who.value: seller verifying their phone, inside a partner app's browser

job.value: get an OTP to verify their mobile number

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: 'Verify mobile number' with 'Secure your Carousell account by verifying your personal mobile phone number' states the job.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The full-width teal 'Get verification code' button is the clear primary.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Get verification code' says exactly what happens, backed by the SMS note below.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: It only asks for the person's own mobile number.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Just one field and one button.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Everything is for this one verification step.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: One subtitle and a short consent line; the field and button carry it.
